package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious package or code is described in the provided report or infographic. The content focuses on general risks, vulnerabilities, and best practices for securing the software supply chain, rather than analyzing a particular malicious package.

behavioral_signatures: Unusual or unauthorized open-source package entry
Unvetted or unscanned third-party code usage
file_indicators: Unreviewed or uncurated open-source package files
Binary files from unknown or untrusted sources
network_indicators: Unexpected outbound connections during build or deployment
Connections to known malicious or untrusted domains from CI/CD pipelines
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor and curate all open-source packages at the point of entry, scan both source and binary code for vulnerabilities, analyze proprietary code for security issues, and detect abnormal network activity during all phases of the software development lifecycle. Employ contextual analysis to reduce false positives and ensure continuous collaboration between development and security teams.
